raw_problem.problem_text:
(a) 证明 定态可以表示为

$$
\psi_ {n} (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L}, (- L / 2 <   x <   L / 2),
$$

其中 $n = 0 , \pm 1 , \pm 2 , \cdot \cdot \cdot$ ，能量的允许值为

$$
E _ {n} = \frac {2}{m} \left(\frac {n \pi \hbar}{L}\right) ^ {2}.
$$

注意 除基态 $( n = 0 )$ 外，所有能级都是二重筒井的.

(b) 假设引入微扰

$$
H ^ {\prime} = - V _ {0} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}},
$$

其中 $a \ll L$ 这个微扰势可以看成是在势场 $x = 0$ 处加上了一个小凹槽，如同将线圈弯了一下，形成了一个小"陷阱气)利用方程 (7.33)，求出 $E _ { n }$ 的一阶修正.提示为了计算积分，需利用 $a \ll L$ 将上下限从 $\pm L / 2$ 扩展到土 $\pm \infty$ 毕竟， $H ^ { \prime }$ 在$- a < x < a$ 范围之外基本为零.

(c) 本题中， $\psi _ { n }$ 和 $\psi _ { - n }$ 的"好"的线性组合是什么? (提示利用方程 (7.27))证明:基于这些态和利用方程 (7.9)，你可以求出一阶修正.

(d) 找到一个满足定理要求的厄米算符 $A$ 并证明: $H ^ { 0 }$ 和 $A$ 的共同本征态就是我们在 中使用过的.
raw_problem.solution_text:
时参考习题 .4 解答过程

(b) 筒并子空间的基矢为

$$
\psi_ {a} ^ {0} (x) = \psi_ {n} (x), \quad \psi_ {b} ^ {0} (x) = \psi_ {- n} (x).
$$

在这个表象中求出 $H ^ { \prime }$ 的矩阵元

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {a a} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- L / 2} ^ {L / 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- L / 2} ^ {L / 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \approx - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} a \sqrt {\pi}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
W _ {b b} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} a \sqrt {\pi} = W _ {a a},
$$

$$
W _ {a b} = \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} (x) \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} (x) \right\rangle = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- L / 2} ^ {L / 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \approx - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(x ^ {2} / a ^ {2} + 4 \pi \mathrm {i n} x a / L\right)} \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 \pi n a / L) ^ {2}} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \left(x + 2 \pi i n a ^ {2} / L\right) ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 \pi n a / L) ^ {2}} a \sqrt {\pi}, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} W _ {b a} = \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} (x) \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} (x) \right\rangle = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- L / 2} ^ {L / 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {4 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {V _ {0}}{L} \mathrm {e} ^ {- (2 \pi n a / L) ^ {2}} a \sqrt {\pi} = W _ {a b}. \\ \end{array}
$$

解久期方程

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} W _ {a a} - E ^ {1} & W _ {a b} \\ W _ {b a} & W _ {b b} - E ^ {1} \end{array} \right| = 0,
$$

得到能量的一阶修正

$$
E _ {\pm} ^ {1} = W _ {a a} \pm | W _ {a b} | = - \frac {a V _ {0}}{L} \sqrt {\pi} \left(1 \mp \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 \pi^ {2} n ^ {2} a ^ {2} / L ^ {2}}\right).
$$

(c) "好"的结性组合系数即 $\alpha$ 与 $\beta$ 它们可以由方程 (7.2η 给出

$$
\beta_ {\pm} = \frac {\alpha_ {\pm} \left(E _ {\pm} ^ {1} - W _ {a a}\right)}{W _ {a b}} = \alpha_ {\pm} \frac {\pm | W _ {a b} |}{W _ {a b}} = \mp \alpha_ {\pm}.
$$

进一步地，根据披函数归一化条件 $| \alpha | ^ { 2 } + | \beta | ^ { 2 } = 1$ ，可以定出线性组合的新披函数为

$$
\psi_ {+} ^ {0} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\psi_ {n} ^ {0} - \psi_ {- n} ^ {0}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 L}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L}\right) = \mathrm {i} \sqrt {\frac {2}{L}} \sin (2 \pi n x / L),
$$

$$
\psi_ {-} ^ {0} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\psi_ {n} ^ {0} + \psi_ {- n} ^ {0}\right) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 L}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L}\right) = \sqrt {\frac {2}{L}} \cos \left(2 \pi n x / L\right).
$$

由它们可以直接求出一阶能量修正

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {+} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle = - \frac {2 V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- L / 2} ^ {L / 2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2} / a ^ {2}} \sin^ {2} \left(2 \pi n x / L\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ \approx - \frac {2 a V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \sin^ {2} \left(2 \pi n a x / L\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {a V _ {0}}{L} \left[ \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x - \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \cos (4 \pi n a x / L) \mathrm {d} x \right] \\ = - \frac {a V _ {0}}{L} \sqrt {\pi} \left(1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 \pi^ {2} n ^ {2} a ^ {2} / L ^ {2}}\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {-} ^ {1} = \left\langle \psi_ {-} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {-} ^ {0} \right\rangle \approx - \frac {2 a V _ {0}}{L} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \cos^ {2} \left(2 \pi n a x / L\right) \mathrm {d} x \\ = - \frac {a V _ {0}}{L} \left[ \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} x + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \mathrm {e} ^ {- x ^ {2}} \cos (4 \pi n a x / L) \mathrm {d} x \right] \\ = - \frac {a V _ {0}}{L} \sqrt {\pi} \left(1 + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 4 \pi^ {2} n ^ {2} a ^ {2} / L ^ {2}}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 中的结果相一致.

(d) 不难看出，字称算符 $P$ 就是满足定理的厄米算符，即 $P f \left( x \right) = f \left( - x \right)$

世宇称算符 $P$ 的本征值为 $\lambda$ ，根据宇称算符的本征方程有

$$
P ^ {2} f (x) = P [ P f (x) ] = P [ \lambda f (x) ] = \lambda P f (x) = \lambda^ {2} f (x) = f (x).
$$

因此，本征值是

$$
\lambda = \pm 1,
$$

所以字称算符与微扰哈密顿算符的共同本征函数可以通过对 $\psi _ { n } \left( x \right)$ 应用上式得到

$$
\psi_ {+} ^ {0} (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x /} L - \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L}\right) = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{\sqrt {L}} \mathrm {i} \sin (2 \pi n x / L) \quad (\text {奇 宇 称})
$$

$$
\psi_ {-} ^ {0} (x) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \frac {1}{\sqrt {L}} \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L} + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 \pi \mathrm {i} n x / L}\right) = \frac {\sqrt {2}}{\sqrt {L}} \cos (2 \pi n x / L) \quad (\text {偶 宇 称})
$$

$( 1 / \sqrt { 2 }$ ;2为归一化困子).

习题 证明:例题 (方程 中计算的一阶能量修正值与精确解(方程(7.21)) $\varepsilon$ 的一阶展开一致.

证明由例题 7.2 $\omega _ { \pm } = \sqrt { 1 \pm \varepsilon } \omega$ E

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {m n} = \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega_ {+} + \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega_ {-} \\ = \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega \sqrt {1 + \varepsilon} + \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega \sqrt {1 - \varepsilon} \\ = \left(m + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega \left(1 + \frac {\varepsilon}{2}\right) + \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega \left(1 - \frac {\varepsilon}{2}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= (m + n + 1) \hbar \omega + \frac {\varepsilon}{2} (m - n) \hbar \omega .
$$

对于例题 7.3 对应的一阶修正，上式要么 $m = 1 , n = 0$ 要么 $m = 0 , \ n = 1$

所以一阶修正项为 $E ^ { 1 } = \pm \frac { \varepsilon } { 2 } \hbar \omega$
